# Hassan Javaid Rao — AI Engineer · Senior Software Engineer

> AI-focused Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years building GCC enterprise logistics systems processing thousands of shipments daily across Oman, UAE and Saudi Arabia. Specialised in applied LLM engineering: multi-agent pipelines, RAG systems, grounded AI assistants and real-time AI voice agents. Initiated and leads the AI programme at one of Oman's largest logistics platforms, and independently built a multi-tenant AI call-agent SaaS. Section Leader at Stanford University's Code in Place programme.

## Experience

**Thiqa Tech — Muscat, Oman (Dec 2021 – present).** Promoted from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer; five years of continuous ownership of the same multi-tenant logistics SaaS platform.

*Senior Software Engineer (Jan 2024 – present)*
- Proposed, architected and leads the platform's AI programme, taking LLM features from concept to production for one of Oman's largest logistics companies (15 branches)
- Designed and shipped a five-agent document-AI pipeline (LangGraph + Gemini) reading handwritten bilingual Arabic/English shipping labels into structured orders, cutting a 12-hour daily data-entry workload to 2–3 hours of review
- Diagnosed the failure that killed the naive single-prompt version (correct digits assigned to the wrong field) and re-architected as one agent per responsibility, making cross-field contamination structurally impossible
- Built a shadow-mode evaluation harness: 2,700+ orders predicted alongside human operators and scored field-by-field, reaching 71.7% of orders billed identically to human entry
- Engineered cost and latency to $0.008 and 23s per order via model routing; one targeted fix cut verification escalations from 78% to 20% of orders
- Built RAG customer chatbots for shippers, and "Ask AI" for operations — a natural-language RAG assistant over shipment data
- Architected and led migration from a single monolith to a modular architecture with zero downtime
- Engineered an AWS Lambda + SQS export pipeline handling millions of records, and an internal real-time chat system (NestJS, MongoDB, Next.js)
- Mentors junior engineers; maintains 99.9% uptime with Sentry and CloudWatch

*Software Engineer (Dec 2021 – Dec 2023)*
- Core engineer on a multi-tenant logistics SaaS built from zero, scaled to thousands of shipments per day and millions of records across Oman, UAE and Saudi Arabia
- Designed role-based access control spanning tenants, branches and operational roles
- Built secure REST APIs with OAuth 2.0 — Password Grant for first-party mobile apps, Client Credentials for machine-to-machine integrations with DHL, AJEX and iMile
- Improved system performance ~20% and introduced Redis-backed queues

**Freelance Full-Stack Developer — Fiverr & Upwork (2020 – 2021).** Top Rated on both platforms with 250+ five-star reviews; 200+ clients across logistics, e-commerce and SaaS.

**Section Leader (Teaching) — Stanford Code in Place (2025).** Competitively selected to teach Python to international learners; led weekly sessions and gave personalised feedback.

## Projects

1. **Waybill Data-Entry Agents — Multi-Agent Document AI (production).** Python (FastAPI), LangGraph, Google Gemini (Flash + Pro), Pillow, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Laravel, Docker. Five single-responsibility agents on a fixed LangGraph state graph with parallel fan-out and a bounded verification/escalation loop. Visual grounding before OCR; constrained selection over free-text generation for location resolution; RAG grounding over similar past orders; LLM-as-judge verification; failure taxonomy separating provider errors from bad model output. https://hassanrao.com/projects/waybill-data-entry-agents
2. **AI Caller — Multi-tenant AI Voice-Agent SaaS (founder, solo build).** Python (FastAPI), Laravel, Vue.js, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Deepgram Voice Agent, Twilio, Google Gemini, AWS. Twilio Media Streams bridged to Deepgram's agent API over WebSockets with barge-in handling and LLM function calling; PDF knowledge bases embedded into pgvector with HNSW cosine indexes; tenant-scoped retrieval with relevance thresholds forcing honest "I don't know" responses; LLM-automated industry onboarding; deployed on AWS EC2 with GitHub Actions CI/CD. https://ai-caller.hassanrao.com
3. **Translation Management API.** PHP 8.2, Laravel, MySQL, Redis, Docker. Controller → Service → Repository architecture, Redis tag-based cache invalidation, cursor-based export streaming millions of records at low memory cost, PHPUnit suite covering API contracts, caching and exports. https://hassanrao.com/projects/translation-api

## Technical Skills

- **AI / LLM engineering:** multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph), RAG pipelines, embeddings & vector search (pgvector), vision & document AI, prompt engineering & grounding, constrained decoding, LLM function/tool calling, LLM-as-judge & offline evaluation, hallucination mitigation, voice agents (Deepgram, Twilio), Google Gemini APIs
- **Backend:** Python (FastAPI), PHP (Laravel), Node.js (NestJS), TypeScript
- **Frontend:** Vue.js, React.js / Next.js, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS (Lambda, SQS, S3, EC2, CloudWatch), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, nginx, Redis
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL (+ pgvector), MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
- **Architecture:** multi-tenant SaaS, modular monolith & microservices, event-driven systems, REST API design, OAuth 2.0 / JWT
- **Quality & monitoring:** Sentry, AWS CloudWatch, PHPUnit, Git, Agile/Scrum
